breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applies thin airfoil theory (a small-angle linear model) to a large angle of attack (20 degrees), where it is invalid due to stall. The ground truth corrects this by pointing out the limitation and suggesting either using a smaller angle or a different model. The generated specification, however, doubles down on the error, explicitly instructing to calculate the lift coefficient at 20 degrees using the linear formula, thereby failing to fix the flawed premise.
